meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会借助 aeon 工具箱帮你处理时间序列机器学习:做分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割、相似性搜索,也可进行特征提取、距离计算、加载标准数据集和对比发布结果。
howto.when: 当你处理带时间索引的数据,或提到时间序列、时序模式等关键词,或要求做分类、预测、异常检测等时序任务时触发。

say.text: 用 STOMP 对这段温度数据做异常检测,画出异常分数图。
把这三组股价序列用 DTW 距离做聚类,显示聚类中心。

howto.what_en: Once active, Claude uses the aeon toolkit for time series machine learning: classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search, plus feature extraction, distance computation, loading standard datasets, and comparing published results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with time-indexed data, mention time series or temporal patterns, or ask for tasks such as classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, etc.

say_en.text: Train a ROCKET classifier on GunPoint data and give test accuracy using aeon.
say_en.note: Claude installs or calls aeon and writes fitting/evaluation code.

say_en.text: Use STOMP to detect anomalies in this temperature series and plot anomaly scores.
say_en.note: Claude calls aeon STOMP and produces a plot.

say_en.text: Cluster these three stock price series with DTW distance and show cluster centers.
